_note: Tool catalog for the agent (05-agent.md §3). Exact JSON schemas are generated from the zod schemas in apps/server/src/agent/tools/*.ts. Every input also has a required 'rationale': {title: string<=60, why: string<=160}. Types refer to types/shared.ts. All tools are sent to Claude in every mode (stable list for caching); the server refuses a tool outside its modes with UNKNOWN_TOOL_FOR_MODE. Risk: meta and read never ask; bankDraft and draft never ask; gated always asks.

tools.name: change_mode
tools.description: Switch to explore (read-only investigation and answers), semantics (agree questions and pin down what the data means) or build (pipelines, objects, links, logic, actions). Build is refused until a semantic version is published.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user 1-3 short questions, with choices when possible (multiple: true for checkboxes, e.g. seed questions). Pauses until they answer.

tools.name: set_plan
tools.description: Create or update the plan shown to the user, in plain language, each step tagged with its stage.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the project's datasets with current version, row count, columns, profile status and whether they are simulated.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Columns (name, type, nullable, sample values) and parse errors of a dataset version.

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: First rows of a dataset (max 50).

tools.name: profile_columns
tools.description: Profile columns from the stored full-table profile: nulls, distinct count, uniqueness, top values, prefix patterns, min/max. Optionally compute how many keys of this dataset match another dataset (one or several columns). Reports 'pending' while the background profile runs.

input.matchAgainst: { datasetId: string; keys: { fromColumn: string; toColumn: string }[] } | undefined

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Read-only SQL (SELECT/WITH) over logic.* (objects with derived properties and rules), ont.* (objects) and data.* (datasets and pipeline outputs). Prefer logic.* and pipeline outputs; don't scan raw order lines to answer a question. Max 500 rows, 5 seconds.

tools.name: bank_overview
tools.description: The semantic bank at a glance: active version and draft, counts, cards still to enrich, open decisions, seed questions and which are covered.

tools.name: browse_semantics
tools.description: Find the definitions, relations and rules related to a query, ranked, with why they matched.

tools.name: resolve_semantics
tools.description: Turn up to 5 mentions ('return rate', 'store') into grounded meaning: where they live in the data, the rules that apply (with the user's decisions) and the evidence. Required before SQL when answering a question; recorded in the trajectory.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Read the published or draft workspace (pipelines, object types, links, logic, actions, apps, automations): whole document, one entity, or an inventory. Draft reads include the latest validation.

input.entity: { kind: EntityKind; apiName: string; objectType?: string } | undefined

tools.name: search_ontology
tools.description: Search object types, properties, links, logic and actions by name, description and aliases. Send several phrasings at once.

tools.name: query_objects
tools.description: Fetch objects from an object set with selected properties, derived properties and rules (max 50 per call).

tools.name: aggregate_objects
tools.description: Count / sum / average objects of a set, optionally grouped by properties.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: One object with all properties, derived properties, rules and its linked objects.

tools.name: get_action_log
tools.description: Recent action runs (who, when, what changed on which objects, status).

tools.name: set_workload
tools.description: Save the user's goal and the seed questions (proposed by you, picked or written by the user).

tools.name: edit_semantics
tools.description: Apply operations to the semantic bank draft: upsert terms, mappings, relations, constraints and evidence (evidence queries are run by the server), resolve a decision, change lifecycle, remove. Returns the new revision and validation.

tools.name: validate_semantics
tools.description: Validate the bank draft: references, closed vocabularies, required fields, no procedural content, open decisions, uncovered questions.

tools.name: publish_semantics
tools.description: Publish the bank draft as the official meaning of the data (new version). Refused while a blocking decision is open. Requires the user's approval.
tools.approvalSummary: Adopt {counts.enriched} definitions, {counts.relations} relations and {counts.constraints} rules as the official meaning of your data

tools.name: edit_draft
tools.description: Apply operations to the workspace draft (upsert pipelines, object types, properties, links, logic, actions, apps, automations; remove; set metadata; set the semantic version). Returns the new revision and validation.

tools.name: preview_pipeline
tools.description: Run a draft pipeline (each output, or one node) on the real inputs with a row limit: rows, row count per node, check results. 30-second limit.

tools.name: test_logic
tools.description: Evaluate draft derived properties and rules on published objects (sample or given keys).

tools.name: validate_draft
tools.description: Validate the draft, including data checks (pipeline checks, unique keys, link match rates, logic cycles). Errors block publishing.

tools.name: diff_draft
tools.description: What publishing the draft would add, change and remove.

tools.name: test_action
tools.description: Dry-run an action as defined in the draft against current objects, including rule criteria evaluated after its edits. Nothing is written.

tools.name: discard_draft
tools.description: Reset the draft to the published version.

tools.name: publish_draft
tools.description: Publish the draft: build pipelines, object views and logic so users see them. One publish at a time. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: run_action
tools.description: Run a published action on real objects. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: enable_automation
tools.description: Switch on a published automation. Only future matches fire. Requires approval.

tools.name: disable_automation
tools.description: Switch off an automation. Requires approval.

tools.name: get_automation_events
tools.description: Recent firings of an automation and what its effects did.

tools.name: adopt_semantic_version
tools.description: Adopt an evolution candidate that won the judge gate as the new active semantic version. Requires approval.
